prompt:
Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

Adult Indian groom, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, slender adult oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, thick dark eyebrows, smooth clean-shaven cheeks and chin, swept wavy black hair with a prominent side part and raised quiff, small relaxed smile. No moustache or beard. Natural adult proportions, not a child. An ivory linen shirt with sleeves rolled, dark sand-colored trousers, bare feet and a fine gold chain. His face and swept quiff match the mountain and ceremony scenes.

Adult Indian bride, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, graceful oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, gently arched black eyebrows, small red bindi, warm reserved smile. Center-parted dark hair in a low bun, small gold jhumka earrings, fine gold necklace and red-and-gold bangles. Natural adult proportions. Preserve her face, skin tone, age and body in every scene. A relaxed maroon evening dress with a light cream shawl and bare feet. Her low bun, bindi and red-and-gold bangles preserve identity; no costume morph.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
The same animated couple stand side by side on open wet beach sand at night, bride LEFT of groom, holding hands while looking toward a breaking wave, shown in relaxed three-quarter profiles. Full bodies and bare feet visible, couple about 57 percent of image height in the middle-left 48 percent of width. She lifts the edge of her evening dress clear of the foam with her free hand; he leans lightly toward her, amused. Feet stay planted throughout this quiet seaside pause, not a repeated formal portrait or ceremony pose. Their feet and evening clothes remain grounded and consistent. EXACTLY ONE SAVE THE DATE BOARD: a simple dark driftwood rectangle with a thin platinum frame on ONE low driftwood easel, firmly standing on dry sand at far RIGHT beyond the waterline. Clear space separates it from the groom. Entire board about 24 percent of frame width, tilted no more than 5 degrees. Exact pearl-white editorial text: 'SAVE THE DATE
6 & 7 FEBRUARY
2020'. No second panel, overlapping border, duplicate stand or reflected second sign. One warm jar lantern sits at its base, already present. No other text. Open navy sky, thin moonlit cloud, sea horizon and foamy water fill the depth. The reception bulbs are tiny distant dots far LEFT, not an enclosing backdrop. Gentle amber light from the lantern balances cool moonlight; moving water reflections stay subtle. A narrow curved tideline leads farther along the shore. Twelve small coastal bubbles and salt-spray beads float at varied depths; all decor stays fixed.
